runtime_contract: Shipping policy, whole decimal order totals 0..1000000. The embedded Lang runtime supplies shipping_total and shipping_print. Run with one total argument: 99 prints 10 and exits 0; 100 prints 0 and exits 0. Missing/invalid totals report a shipping diagnostic on stderr and exit 64. Target: LLVM Linux x86-64 with system libc; no managed collector or VM. Arguments and emitted fees are whole units. Native mode is -O0.
